title: Towards Co-Designed Event-Triggered Extremum Seeking
summary: This paper studies event-triggered gradient-based multivariable extremum seeking for nonlinear maps with polytopic Hessian uncertainty. Unlike existing event-triggered extremum-seeking methods, which first fix the controller (typically diagonal) and then design the triggering mechanism, the proposed approach jointly synthesizes the controller and the triggering mechanism through a co-design framework that admits both diagonal and full controller gain matrices.
